name: Dominoes
description: Classic 2-player draw dominoes with the standard double-six set. Each player draws a hand of tiles and takes turns adding to a single line, matching pip values at the open ends. If you cannot play, you draw from the boneyard until you can. First to empty their hand wins; if the game is blocked, the lighter hand wins. A game of memory, counting and tile management.

phases.name: play
phases.description: Players alternate placing tiles on the line.

entity_types.name: DominoPlayer
entity_types.description: A dominoes player. Holds a concealed hand of tiles and plays them onto the line.

properties.name: tiles_in_hand
properties.description: Number of tiles still in this player's hand.

properties.name: tile_management
properties.description: 0 = plays reactively, 1 = carefully manages suits, counts tiles and blocks the opponent.

actions.name: play_tile
actions.description: Place one tile from your hand onto the line. REQUIRED: `tile` — a tile from your hand like '3-5' — and `end` — 'left' or 'right', which open end of the line to attach it to. The tile must share a pip value with that end (see `playable_moves` in your perception). On the very first move the line is empty and any tile may be played.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Which open end to play on: 'left' or 'right'.

actions.name: draw_tile
actions.description: Draw one tile from the boneyard. Available only when you have no playable tile and the boneyard is not empty.

actions.name: pass
actions.description: Pass your turn. Available only when you have no playable tile and the boneyard is empty.

agent_archetypes.name: Calculating Counter
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Tracks which suits have been played and what the opponent has drawn or passed on. Plays to starve the opponent of matches and control both ends of the line.

agent_archetypes.name: Balanced Player
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Plays a solid all-round game — sheds heavy tiles early, keeps options open, and blocks when the chance appears.

agent_archetypes.name: Instinctive Player
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Plays quickly on feel — usually the first reasonable tile — without deep counting or blocking plans.

runtime_parameters.name: sample_size
runtime_parameters.label: Number of Players
runtime_parameters.description: Dominoes here is played as a 2-player game.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.dominoes.hand_size
runtime_parameters.label: Tiles per Hand
runtime_parameters.description: How many tiles each player draws at the start.

runtime_parameters.name: premise
runtime_parameters.label: Scenario Premise
runtime_parameters.description: Optional framing — e.g. 'café championship' or 'AI exhibition match'.

termination_conditions.name: hand_emptied
termination_conditions.description: End the game when a player plays their last tile.

termination_conditions.name: blocked_draw
termination_conditions.description: End the game if it is blocked and tied on pips.
